about: Semi-retired music teacher who gives a few private lessons and directs a small community choir

messages.subject: October at the library: author talks, knitting circle and more
messages.body: Hello neighbor! Here is what is happening at Hollowell Public Library this October. Author talk with a local historian on Oct 8, the knitting circle every Wednesday, and the used book sale on Oct 24 in the community room. Remember you can renew items online from your account page. See you soon!

messages.subject: Lunch for Marguerite
messages.body:
Hi Odile,

A few of us from the old music department are taking Marguerite out for lunch to celebrate her retirement. Linden Bistro, Saturday Oct 10 at 12:30. She would be so happy to see you there. Can you let me know by Wednesday so I can give them a headcount?

All best,
Harold

messages.subject: Re: Lunch for Marguerite
messages.body:
Harold, count me in! Wouldn't miss it. I'll bring a card for everyone to sign.

Odile

messages.subject: Une petite nouvelle
messages.body:
Chère Odile,

Je t'écris avec une grande nouvelle : ma fille a eu son bébé la semaine dernière ! C'est une petite fille, elle s'appelle Clémence et elle est magnifique. Nous sommes tous très fatigués mais aussi très heureux.

Et toi, comment vas-tu ? Est-ce que ta chorale prépare toujours le concert de décembre ? Je pense souvent à nos étés à Lyon avec le piano de ma mère.

Je t'embrasse,
Hélène

messages.subject: Re: Une petite nouvelle
messages.body:
Ma chère Hélène,

Quelle belle nouvelle, félicitations à toute la famille ! Clémence, c'est un très joli prénom. Envoie-moi une photo quand tu peux.

Oui, la chorale prépare le concert pour le 13 décembre, avec des chants de Noël anglais. Je pense aussi souvent à ces étés et au vieux piano de ta mère.

Gros bisous,
Odile

messages.subject: Reminder: 1 item due soon
messages.body: This is an automated reminder. The following item is due in 3 days: A Life in Song (large print). Renew online or at the front desk. Thank you for using Hollowell Public Library.

messages.subject: October lessons
messages.body:
Hi Mrs. Fairweather,

Could you send me an invoice for Hazel's October piano lessons? My employer's benefits program reimburses part of it but they need a proper invoice with dates. Sorry for the bother!

Thanks,
Grace

messages.subject: Re: October lessons
messages.body:
Hi Grace,

No bother at all. Attached is the invoice for Hazel's four October lessons (Oct 6, 13, 20 and 27), $45 each, $180 total, marked paid. Let me know if they need anything else on it.

Best,
Odile Fairweather

messages.subject: Zolder van papa
messages.body:
Lieve Odile,

Ik ben eindelijk begonnen met de zolder van papa op te ruimen. Ik vond zijn oude metronoom en een doos met liedboeken van het koor waar hij in zong. Wil jij die hebben? Anders gaan ze naar de kringloop, maar dat vind ik zonde.

Laat het me maar weten, dan stuur ik het op. Het is niet zo zwaar.

Dikke kus,
Marijke

messages.subject: Re: Zolder van papa
messages.body:
Lieve Marijke,

Ja, graag! Die metronoom stond altijd op de piano, ik heb er nog als kind mee geoefend. Stuur het maar op, ik betaal de verzendkosten wel terug. Dank je wel dat je daar aan dacht.

Liefs,
Odile

messages.subject: Re: Zolder van papa
messages.body:
Het pakket is vandaag op de post gegaan! Het zou er binnen twee weken moeten zijn. Je hoeft niets terug te betalen hoor, het is een cadeautje van papa.

Kus,
Marijke

messages.subject: Fernhill Garden Club: November newsletter
messages.body: Dear members, the dahlias are lifted and the bulbs are in! This month: our plant swap on Saturday Nov 21 at the community center, a talk on winter pruning, and a reminder that dues for next year can be paid by check at any meeting. Happy gardening!

messages.subject: Clases de violín de Mateo
messages.body:
Hola Odile,

Mateo está muy contento con las clases de violín, gracias por tu paciencia con él. Te quería preguntar una cosa: ¿es posible pagar las clases una vez al mes en lugar de cada semana? Para nosotros es más fácil así por el trabajo de mi marido.

Muchas gracias y saludos,
Sofía

messages.subject: Re: Clases de violín de Mateo
messages.body:
Hola Sofía,

Claro que sí, no hay problema. Podemos hacerlo así: pagas el primer sábado de cada mes por todas las clases del mes. Mateo trabaja muy bien, y su sonido es cada vez más bonito.

Un saludo,
Odile

messages.subject: Appointment reminder: annual checkup
messages.body: This is a reminder of your upcoming appointment: Annual checkup with Dr. Patel, Wednesday Dec 2 at 10:00 AM, Ashgrove Health Center, 2nd floor. Please arrive 15 minutes early and bring your insurance card. To reschedule, call the front desk. Do not reply to this message.

messages.subject: Cabin in April??
messages.body:
Odile!! My brother-in-law has finally fixed up his cabin near Shenandoah and says we can have it for a weekend in April. Hiking, porch, a fire, no phones. You, me and Lorraine like the old days. He's still working out which weekends are free, I'll send you dates as soon as I hear from him. Say yes!

xo Bea

messages.subject: Re: Cabin in April??
messages.body:
Yes, yes and yes. My April is wide open after the choir's spring break starts. Send dates whenever he has them and I'll put it straight on the calendar.

Odile

messages.subject: Your November statement is ready
messages.body: Your monthly statement for account ending 4471 is now available in online banking. This is an automated message, please do not reply.

messages.subject: Your piano is due for its tuning
messages.body:
Hello Mrs. Fairweather,

It has been about a year since I last tuned your home grand, so this is my friendly reminder. With the heating season starting it usually drifts a bit. I have openings the first week of December. Just reply with a morning that suits you.

Regards,
Desmond Pell
Pell Piano Tuning

messages.subject: Re: Your piano is due for its tuning
messages.body:
Hi Desmond, good timing, the top octave has been sounding sour. Thursday Dec 3 in the morning would be perfect if you have it.

Thanks,
Odile

messages.subject: Re: Your piano is due for its tuning
messages.body:
You're booked: Thursday Dec 3 at 9:30. I'll take a look at that top octave too. See you then.

Desmond

messages.subject: Your hold is ready for pickup
messages.body: Good news! The item you placed on hold is ready: The Choral Director's Handbook. It will be held at the front desk for 7 days. Hollowell Public Library.

messages.subject: band concert!!
messages.body:
hi grandma

our winter band concert is thursday dec 10 at 6:30 in the school gym. we are playing Shenandoah and i have a little trumpet solo in the middle!! mom said you would want to know. can you come?

love theo

messages.subject: Re: band concert!!
messages.body:
Theo, a trumpet solo! I am so proud of you. Of course I'll be there, front row if they let me. Keep practicing that long note at the end.

Love,
Grandma

messages.subject: Chairs for Saturday?
messages.body:
Hi Odile,

We're short on seating for the plant swap tomorrow (Saturday the 21st, 2 to 4 at the community center). You mentioned you have some folding chairs in your garage. Could you bring three or four? Happy to swing by and pick them up if that's easier.

Thanks a bunch,
Tobias
Fernhill Garden Club

messages.subject: Re: Chairs for Saturday?
messages.body:
Of course, Tobias. I'll bring four chairs around 1:30 so you can set up. I may also bring a few hellebore seedlings for the table.

Odile

messages.subject: Lily's lesson this Saturday
messages.body:
Hi Odile, would it be possible to move Lily's lesson this Saturday (Nov 28) from 10 to 11? We have a family breakfast that runs late. If not, no worries, we'll make 10 work.

Thanks,
Tobias Wren

messages.subject: Re: Lily's lesson this Saturday
messages.body:
Hi Tobias, 11 is fine this week. See Lily then. Tell her to bring the minuet!

Odile

messages.subject: Thursday
messages.body:
Hi Mom, we're eating at 3 on Thursday. Could you bring a pie? The kids keep asking for your pumpkin one. Theo told me he invited you to his concert, he's over the moon.

Love you,
Annelies

messages.subject: Re: Thursday
messages.body:
Pumpkin pie it is, and I'll bring whipped cream. See you at 3, sweetheart.

Mom

messages.subject: Holiday concerts: last seats available
messages.body: Join us for our holiday program! A few seats remain for the Dec 19 and Dec 20 performances. Subscribers get 15% off with their member code. Book online today.

messages.subject: Hazel is sick
messages.body:
Hi Mrs. Fairweather, Hazel came down with a fever last night so we need to skip her lesson on Tuesday. So sorry for the short notice. Could we make it up the following week, or should we just skip it?

Grace

messages.subject: Hall booking confirmed: fall season and Dec 13 concert
messages.body:
Dear Odile,

This confirms the main hall for Brackenridge Community Choir: Tuesday rehearsals 7 to 9 PM from Sept 29 through Dec 8, and Sunday Dec 13 from 1 PM for the concert at 4. The rate is the same as last year. Could you just reply to confirm you received this?

Kind regards,
Pauline Rourke
St. Peter's Hall

messages.subject: Re: Hall booking confirmed: fall season and Dec 13 concert
messages.body:
Received, thank you Pauline. All looks right. See you Tuesday.

Odile

messages.subject: Choral Guild fall newsletter
messages.body: In this issue: warming up an aging voice, a spotlight on three small-town choirs, and the dates for the spring festival. Member choirs can enroll for the festival from January 15. Thank you for singing with us!

messages.subject: Board minutes + repertoire list
messages.body:
Hi Odile,

Minutes from Thursday's board meeting are attached. One action for you: could you send me the final repertoire list for the December concert by Nov 1? I want to start on the program layout early this year.

Thanks,
Wendell
Secretary

messages.subject: Re: Board minutes + repertoire list
messages.body:
Hi Wendell, here it is, early for once:

1. The Holly and the Ivy
2. Wassail Song
3. In the Bleak Midwinter
4. Ding Dong Merrily on High
5. Silent Night (with audience)

The order may shift a little but the pieces are final.

Odile

messages.subject: Joining the choir?
messages.body:
Hello, I just moved to Brackenridge and saw your flyer at the library. I sang soprano in my college choir but haven't sung in years. Are you taking new members, and is there an audition?

Best,
Imogen Takahashi

messages.subject: Re: Joining the choir?
messages.body:
Hi Imogen, welcome to town! We'd love to have you, and there's no audition. Just come to a Tuesday rehearsal, 7 PM at St. Peter's Hall. We'll have music for you there.

Odile Fairweather
Director, Brackenridge Community Choir

messages.subject: Order for Brackenridge Community Choir
messages.body:
Hello,

I'd like to order 40 copies each of The Holly and the Ivy (SATB) and Wassail Song (SATB). We have 34 singers, so the extra copies are spares for newcomers and lost folders. Please ship to the choir address on file and invoice the choir.

Thank you,
Odile Fairweather

messages.subject: Re: Order for Brackenridge Community Choir
messages.body:
Hi Odile,

Thanks for your order! Both titles are in stock. Invoice #20871 for $212.00 is attached, payable within 30 days by check or online. You'll get a shipping notice when it leaves the warehouse.

Clara Benning
Harbinger Music Supply

messages.subject: Your order has shipped
messages.body: Order #20871 has shipped and should arrive in 3 to 5 business days. Track your package from your account page. This mailbox is not monitored.

messages.subject: Zwei Proben verpasst
messages.body:
Liebe Odile,

ich muss dir leider sagen, dass ich die Proben am 3. und 10. November nicht schaffe. Meine Mutter in Freiburg ist gestürzt und ich fliege für zwei Wochen zu ihr. Es geht ihr aber schon besser.

Ich übe die Stücke zu Hause, versprochen. Ist das in Ordnung für dich?

Viele Grüße,
Jürgen

messages.subject: Re: Zwei Proben verpasst
messages.body:
Lieber Jürgen,

das ist natürlich kein Problem. Die Familie geht vor! Ich wünsche deiner Mutter gute Besserung. Wenn du zurück bist, frag einfach den Stimmführer der Bässe, er hat alle Notizen.

Herzliche Grüße und gute Reise,
Odile

messages.subject: Heating problem in the main hall
messages.body:
Good morning Odile,

The boiler for the main hall stopped working over the weekend. A technician is coming tomorrow morning. If he can't fix it, tomorrow evening's rehearsal may need to move to the small annex room, or be canceled. I'll let you know by noon tomorrow.

Apologies,
Pauline

messages.subject: Where are we tomorrow?
messages.body:
Hi Odile, I heard a rumor from one of the tenors that the hall has no heat. Are we still on for tomorrow? I carpool with two other altos so I'd like to tell them.

Nora

messages.subject: Re: Where are we tomorrow?
messages.body:
Hi Nora, the rumor is true, but a technician is coming in the morning. I'll know by noon and will write to you then.

Odile

messages.subject: Re: Heating problem in the main hall
messages.body:
Good news: the boiler is fixed and the hall is warming up already. Tonight's rehearsal is on as usual in the main hall.

Pauline

messages.subject: Re: Where are we tomorrow?
messages.body:
All fixed! Rehearsal tonight at 7 in the main hall as usual. See you there.

Odile

messages.subject: Member deals: choir folders 20% off
messages.body: Guild members save 20% on black ring-binder choir folders through December from our partner supplier. Also inside: holiday concert tips and a free warm-up sheet to download.

messages.subject: Hall piano
messages.body:
Odile, the upright in the hall sounded rough last Tuesday, especially the middle C area. Should we get it tuned before the concert? Pauline says the hall always uses Rosemary Quill at Keystone Tuning and I can book her directly. About $140, which the choir budget can cover.

Felix
Treasurer

messages.subject: Re: Hall piano
messages.body:
Yes please, Felix. Book Rosemary for any day before Dec 13, ideally before our last rehearsal. Thank you for handling it.

Odile

messages.subject: Re: Hall piano
messages.body:
Done. Rosemary is tuning it Tuesday Dec 8 at 2, so it'll be fresh for that evening's rehearsal. Pauline will let her in.

Felix

messages.subject: This week only: choir folders 20% off
messages.body: Stock up before the holiday concerts! Choir folders, pencil clips and stand lights are 20% off this week. Free shipping on orders over $75.

messages.subject: Concert program: printer deadline
messages.body:
Hi Odile, the printer needs the final program by Friday Nov 20 to have copies ready for the 13th. I have the layout done. Could you send the final running order and the short director's note you wrote last year (updated)?

Wendell

messages.subject: Re: Concert program: printer deadline
messages.body:
Hi Wendell, final running order and director's note attached. I swapped In the Bleak Midwinter and Wassail Song so we end the first half on something lively. Thanks for all your work on this.

Odile

messages.subject: Alto practice tracks
messages.body:
Hi Odile, I've recorded the alto lines for all five pieces and put them in the shared folder, same place as the soprano ones. Let me know if any tempos feel off.

Lionel

messages.subject: Re: Alto practice tracks
messages.body:
Lionel, you're a star. Tempos sound just right. I'll mention them at Tuesday's rehearsal.

Odile

messages.subject: Weekly digest: 3 new messages
messages.body: This week on the members list: carpool offers for Tuesday, a photo from last rehearsal, and a reminder to wear black on Dec 13. Visit the list page to read and reply.

messages.subject: Lost my Wassail Song
messages.body:
Hi Odile, embarrassing, but I think I left my copy of Wassail Song on the bus. Is there a spare I could take on Tuesday? Happy to pay for it.

Thanks, Ruth

promises.what: come to the Dec 10 band concert
bring four folding chairs to the plant swap
bring a pumpkin pie on Thursday
tune the home piano on Dec 3 at 9:30
send dates for the April cabin weekend
book the hall piano tuning before the concert

traps.what: Two people with the first name Tobias ask Saturday favors; garden club chairs and a lesson move are unrelated and both handled.
Shenandoah is both Bea's cabin location and the piece in Theo's band concert; unrelated, different months.
Home piano tuning with Desmond and the choir's hall piano tuning look combinable, but one is personal and Felix already booked the hall's own tuner.
Hall heating outage and Nora's question suggest telling members about a venue move, but the boiler was fixed the next day.
Choir folders 20% off shows up twice, but only in a guild newsletter and a supplier promo.
